LESSON: READING FOR INFORMATION

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: MANDARIN
Strand: Reading
Topic 2.1: Reading for Information
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading for Information, part of Reading in Grade 9 MANDARIN.

Key inquiry question: How can we effectively summarise information from texts?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. read out formal greetings and their responses,

2. match countries (肯尼亚、乌干 达、坦桑尼亚、中国、美国、 英国、法国、德国、阿拉伯) with the languages spoken (英 语、斯瓦希里语、德语、法 语)and read them out,

3. read a text on the introduction of self and others (formal greeting, name, age, place of origin, residence, nationality, and language spoken) and answer the given questions,

4. take turns paraphrasing the texts on the introduction of self and others,

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. read out formal greetings and their responses,
2. match countries (肯尼亚、乌干 达、坦桑尼亚、中国、美国、 英国、法国、德国、阿拉伯) with the languages spoken (英 语、斯瓦希里语、德语、法 语)and read them out,
3. read a text on the introduction of self and others (formal greeting, name, age, place of origin, residence, nationality, and language spoken) and answer the given questions,
4. take turns paraphrasing the texts on the introduction of self and others,

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading for Information together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Creativity and Imagination: the learner undertakes group tasks and exchanges ideas that inspire creative thinking as they

search for key information during the scavenger hunt game.

• Communication and Collaboration: the learner recognises the value of others’ ideas when they take turns paraphrasing the

information in texts.

Values:
Patriotism: love for own country is developed when the learner interacts with texts on languages spoken in different countries.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Cultural awareness is developed as the learner appreciates the various nationalities and languages spoken.

Link to Other Learning Areas:

The learner is able to relate the concept of different countries and nationalities to their learning in Social Studies.
